news.title: Michael Burry Says His Portfolio Was Discussed 'About the Time the Market Reversed Off Its Lows': He Is 'Temporarily Almost Entirely Long'
news.summary: Michael Burry‘s move to a portfolio that is almost entirely long was discussed on financial news just as U.S. stocks reversed off their lows on Wednesday, the ‘Big Short’ investor noted. Timing Of His Portfolio Review Burry told subscribers of his Substack, ‘Cassandra Unchained,’ earlier Wednesday that his portfolio is more long and less short than it has been in some time. “My portfolio review was discussed on CNBC about the time the market reversed off its lows today,” he said in a post on X.
